correctness.rationale: For every prime power q and interior rank 2<=r<=n-2, conjugation sets Q=diag(I_r,0_s). Each rank-one idempotent uniquely equals uv^T up to q-1 reciprocal scalings, with v.u=1. Block multiplication gives C=[[0,-ad^T],[bc^T,0]], C^3=alpha(alpha-1)C and rank C equal to the sum of the two nonzero block indicators. The nonzero-alpha companion block follows since C is cyclic on its 2D image. Nilpotent ranks 0,1,2 give 0,J2,J3; zero and nonzero vector/covector fibers give the exact seven-row table. Sum is q^(n-1)(q^n-1)/(q-1); limiting rank law follows from the exact counts. Independently enumerated 120 (q=2,n=4,r=2), 1080 (3,4,2) and 496 (2,5,2) normalized outer products, including trace/rank and cubic-law checks. These finite enumerations do not prove all fields or dimensions.
residual_risks: Finite computations corroborate but do not replace the unrestricted proof.
